map.为何往返不是算术均？: Why is a round trip not the arithmetic mean?
map.慢速段耗时更长、权重更大，调和均按时间加权，正确反映总耗时。: Slower legs take longer and carry more weight; the harmonic mean weights by time and therefore reflects the true total duration.
